title: ID0464164-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000] Dispensers are offline
description: Reported behaviour/issue: The dispensers are offline, and it is not possible to start a charging process. A restart has already been carried out on-site and remotely.

additional_info.subject: ID0464164-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000] Dispensers are offline CRM:02681001145
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin :)
I see in the logs that the charger was ready to give at least 170kW:
And since the EV didn't ask for more than 30kW, we never reach it.
The charger waited around 3 mins to perform the logic so the EV is really just requesting a slow charge.
Since everything has been answered, I will close the ticket. If you have any more questions or doubts, feel free to reach out to us again. I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you and have a nice rest of the week.
Best regards,
Francisco
